description: DESIGN KITS: a ready design idea made of the variables we already have (style, colour and light from Promt/trends.json, decor from our own prompts). The director (reels_pipeline/director.py) composes a photo card and a clip from a kit and a ROLE (specs/roles.json). Rules every kit follows, checked by the director: decor stands on the SIDE wall (`side_wall`, away from the mural), a ceiling fixture hangs high above the top edge of the mural, nothing stands in front of the mural, everything is low. Placeholders: {side} = LEFT / RIGHT (the side wall with the decor), {far_side} = the opposite one, {person} = the person of the role. One kit = one age group (baby = under 2, vorschul = 2-5, schulkind = 6-10). `room_type` (a name of `roomZones` in Promt/trends.json: sleep zone | play zone | reading nook | study zone) and `child` {gender: boy | girl | neutral, age_band: a key of `ageGroups` in Promt/trends.json} are the explicit fields a set can ask for (they must agree with `audience` and `age`). In `life_pose` / `life_action` write the child's pronouns as {her} (his/her), {she} and {him}: the director fills them from the SAME gender as the person's words, a hard-coded his/her puts a boy's pronoun on a girl. Texts are positive ('describe what you want'), in English, written to the Google / OpenAI image-prompting guides.

kits.name: Botanical play mat

kits.light: Soft afternoon light falls from a window on the {side} and lies evenly on the floor.
kits.palette: soft lilac, blush, ivory, pale eucalyptus green and light oak
kits.items: play mat, baby play gym, rabbit, stool, plant, picture frames and architecture
kits.life_pose: {person} kneels on the play mat with {her} back to the camera, one hand resting on the play gym, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kits.life_action: slowly reaches out, lifts the soft rabbit from the mat and holds it up in front of {him}
